label: Select agents: theft, loss or release (42 CFR 73.19)
authority: CDC Division of Regulatory Science and Compliance and USDA APHIS Agricultural Select Agent Services
statusNote: The written report is due within seven calendar days; one training slide treats three days as late, and the regulation controls. Check the program's current guidance and your registration.

triggers.label: Theft or loss discovered
triggers.hint: The moment the entity discovers a theft or loss of a select agent or toxin, even if it is later recovered.

triggers.label: Release discovered
triggers.hint: A release causing occupational exposure, or outside the primary barriers of the biocontainment area.

clocks.label: Immediate notice of theft or loss
clocks.rule: Immediately on discovery, by telephone, facsimile or e-mail. The framework needs a duration, so the clock marks 1 minute as 'at once'.

clocks.label: Notice to law enforcement of theft or loss
clocks.recipient: Federal, state or local law enforcement
clocks.rule: Immediately on discovery of a theft or loss, to the appropriate agencies. Marked as 1 minute for 'at once'.

clocks.label: Form 3 for theft or loss
clocks.rule: A completed APHIS/CDC Form 3 within seven calendar days. Exercise worksheets are not the official form.

clocks.label: Immediate notice of release
clocks.rule: Immediately on discovery, by telephone, facsimile or e-mail. Marked as 1 minute for 'at once'.

clocks.label: Form 3 for release
clocks.rule: A completed APHIS/CDC Form 3 within seven calendar days.

appliesTo.note: Entities registered for select agents and toxins. Your registration and institutional policy may be stricter.
